scope: 14 archived directed Seurat rows; 10 distinct molecular pairs
local_contact_validation: Predicted for every row; direct binding status refers to published experiments in their reported systems.

pairs.title: Direct binding supported
pairs.assay: Recombinant affinity binding and splice-selectivity assays; synaptic immunogold localization.
pairs.experimental_context: Biochemical studies and rodent neuronal synapses; the specific P60 CA1-to-C1 contact remains a prediction.
pairs.molecular_form: Alpha/beta neurexin and neuroligin splice variants have different binding properties. Nuclear gene counts do not identify the binding-competent isoforms.

locations.Nlgn1: Predominantly postsynaptic membrane at glutamatergic synapses

pairs.interpretation: For these expression endpoints, CA1 NRXN1 with IN C1 NLGN1 predicts excitatory CA1-to-interneuron transmission. The reciprocal LIANA entry describes the same adhesion pair and the same proposed synaptic orientation.

pairs.title: Direct binding supported
pairs.assay: Recombinant extracellular-domain binding, mutagenesis and structural analysis.
pairs.experimental_context: Contactin/PTPRG biochemical studies; cis complexes demonstrated in retinal photoreceptors and trans binding in apposed transfected cells.
pairs.molecular_form: CNTN3 is GPI-anchored. PTPRG is a receptor-type phosphatase. Cis and trans interactions are possible.

locations.Cntn3: Extracellular face of the neuronal membrane; pre/post assignment unresolved here
locations.Ptprg: Cell-surface receptor phosphatase; pre/post assignment unresolved here

pairs.interpretation: IN C6 CNTN3-to-CA1 PTPRG is a candidate cell-surface recognition/signalling relationship. The two genes do not determine which cell supplies the presynaptic terminal.

references.label: Nikolaienko et al. 2016, cis and trans contexts

pairs.title: Direct binding supported
pairs.assay: Mouse SLIT1-ROBO1 binding assays; subsequent Slit-domain binding studies.
pairs.experimental_context: Embryonic expression and axon-guidance experiments; subtype-specific mature CA1 action remains unresolved.
pairs.molecular_form: Secreted SLIT1 engages a cell-surface ROBO receptor. The mature active ligand domain and heparan-sulfate context matter.

locations.Slit1: Secreted extracellular guidance cue; no fixed pre/post side
locations.Robo1: Cell surface, including axons/growth cones in guidance studies; P60 C6 compartment unresolved

pairs.interpretation: Molecular signal is proposed from deep CA1 SLIT1 to IN C6 ROBO1. Axon guidance repulsion does not specify an inhibitory synaptic current or a direction of neurotransmitter release.

references.label: Yuan et al. 1999, exact mouse SLIT1-ROBO1 pair

pairs.title: Direct binding supported
pairs.assay: SLIT2 cell-surface binding to APP, binding curves and APP E1 deletion experiments; downstream shedding and axon-guidance assays.
pairs.experimental_context: Heterologous cells, neuronal/olfactory cultures and developmental guidance models; mature CA1-to-SST contacts untested.
pairs.molecular_form: SLIT2 binds the extracellular E1 domain of membrane APP and can trigger ectodomain shedding.

locations.Slit2: Secreted extracellular cue; pre/post site unresolved
locations.App: Membrane protein with axonal and dendritic pools; cleavage generates soluble products

pairs.interpretation: IN C6 SLIT2-to-superficial CA1 APP has direct molecular support in other systems. The RNA data leave the receiving APP membrane compartment unresolved.

references.label: Wang et al. 2017, Figure 6 and downstream assays

pairs.title: Direct binding supported; fragment dependent
pairs.assay: Binding of SLIT C-terminal fragment to PlexinA1; complexes from spinal tissue and functional guidance assays.
pairs.experimental_context: Developing spinal commissural axons, with later mouse/chicken functional work; mature CA1 synapse localization untested.
pairs.molecular_form: SLIT-C binds PLXNA1. SLIT-N instead engages ROBO1/2. Gene-level Slit2 counts do not measure cleavage or SLIT-C abundance.

locations.Slit2: Secreted SLIT-C fragment required for this binding relationship
locations.Plxna1: Cell-surface guidance receptor, including growth cones; pre/post assignment unresolved in P60 CA1

pairs.interpretation: Proposed molecular direction is IN C6 SLIT-C to superficial or deep CA1 PLXNA1. The effect on synaptic excitation/inhibition is unresolved.

pairs.title: Direct binding supported; isoform qualification
pairs.assay: Affinity purification and quantified PTN binding to phosphacan; membrane PTPRZ signalling assays.
pairs.experimental_context: Rat brain-derived protein and cultured-cell studies; cell-resolved P60 CA1-to-C1 binding remains untested.
pairs.molecular_form: Ptprz1 encodes transmembrane receptor isoforms and soluble phosphacan. Gene-level RNA and shared peptides do not resolve these forms.

locations.Ptn: Secreted, extracellular-matrix-associated ligand; no fixed pre/post side
locations.Ptprz1: Cell-surface receptor isoforms and secreted phosphacan; P60 IN C1 isoform and pre/post location unresolved

pairs.interpretation: CA1 PTN-to-IN C1 PTPRZ1 is a supported ligand-receptor family relationship. Local, diffuse or matrix-associated action is possible; synaptic transmission direction is unresolved.

references.label: Meng et al. 2000, membrane PTPRZ signalling

pairs.title: Binding screen support
pairs.assay: Human recombinant extracellular-protein ELISA screen (apECIA), Data S4 row 75. Mean signal/background 2.883 across three assay replicates; observed in one bait/prey orientation. No matching pair in Data S5 SPR conditions.
pairs.experimental_context: High-throughput human extracellular-protein screen; mouse CA1 function and native cell-surface binding require validation.
pairs.molecular_form: FSTL5 is secreted; CNTN5 is GPI-anchored and lacks an intracellular signalling domain.

locations.Fstl5: Secreted extracellular protein; release site unresolved
locations.Cntn5: GPI-anchored cell-surface adhesion protein; pre/post assignment unresolved here

pairs.interpretation: IN C1 FSTL5-to-superficial CA1 CNTN5 is supported at screening level. The screen establishes a candidate extracellular association, with native synaptic organization unresolved.

pairs.title: Pathway crosstalk; direct binding unverified
pairs.assay: SLIT/ROBO and netrin/DCC pathway crosstalk, receptor-complex/co-immunoprecipitation and genetic guidance studies. Direct SLIT2-DCC extracellular binding was not established in the reviewed evidence.
pairs.experimental_context: Developing forebrain/spinal guidance models. The historical Stein/Tessier-Lavigne 2001 report was retracted and is excluded as supporting evidence.
pairs.molecular_form: DCC is a netrin receptor. ROBO and DCC pathway cooperation does not identify DCC as a direct SLIT2 receptor.

locations.Dcc: Netrin receptor on neuronal membranes/growth cones; mature CA1 pre/post assignment unresolved

pairs.interpretation: Retain this row as an indirect guidance candidate. A direct IN C6 SLIT2-to-deep CA1 DCC ligand-binding arrow is unsupported by the reviewed evidence.

references.label: Dailey-Krempel et al. 2023, genetic pathway interaction

pairs.title: Direct binding unverified
pairs.assay: Both entries occur in the frozen mouseconsensus. In upstream LRdb the source is Reactome and the pair-specific PMID field is empty. Human CellTalkDB cites PMID 32196115, the SingleCellSignalR resource paper. No direct binding assay for this exact pair was verified.
pairs.experimental_context: Database provenance only for the exact APP-GRM7 pair; co-detection in SynDive is independent protein coverage.
pairs.molecular_form: APP has full-length and cleaved forms. Glutamate is the established endogenous mGluR7 agonist. Secreted APP binding to GABABR1a is a separate experimentally supported mechanism.

locations.App: Axonal/dendritic membrane pools and soluble cleavage products; local form unresolved
locations.Grm7: Predominantly presynaptic release-site receptor on glutamatergic or GABAergic terminals

pairs.interpretation: IN C1 Grm7 RNA can contribute to presynaptic mGluR7 on inhibitory axons. Its partner and target cell are unresolved. Reversing this database arrow would not establish an APP-GRM7 binding mechanism.

references.label: Okamoto et al. 1994, glutamate agonist pharmacology
Rice et al. 2019, separate sAPP-GABABR1a binding

pairs.title: Direct binding unverified
pairs.assay: Both entries occur in the frozen mouseconsensus. In upstream LRdb the source is Reactome and the pair-specific PMID field is empty. Human CellTalkDB cites PMID 32196115, the SingleCellSignalR resource paper. No direct binding assay for this exact pair was verified.
pairs.experimental_context: Database provenance only for the exact PENK-GRM7 pair.
pairs.molecular_form: PENK is a precursor of processed enkephalin peptides, whose established targets include mu/delta opioid receptors. Enkephalin-mGluR7 binding was not verified.

locations.Penk: Secreted processed neuropeptides; precursor RNA does not measure release
locations.Grm7: Predominantly presynaptic release-site receptor on glutamatergic or GABAergic terminals

pairs.interpretation: The source/target expression changes identify two candidate molecular changes. The receptor-bearing IN C1 terminal remains presynaptic in a physiological schematic. The PENK-GRM7 binding direction is unresolved.

references.label: Mansour et al. 1995, enkephalin-opioid receptor binding
